pages.text: Familiar Rings consist of a $(item)Soul Gem$(), that contains a $(#AA00AA)Djinni$(), mounted on a ring.$(br) In this 1.12 port the ring stores supported local familiar substitutes for transport and release; a native one-slot player accessory also applies supported $()

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use a $(item)Familiar Ring$(), capture a supported summoned and tamed familiar by $(#AA00AA)right-clicking$() it with an empty ring.$(br2)Right-click air with a filled ring to equip it, or right-click a block to release the stored familiar; $()

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: sneak-right-click empty air to remove the equipped ring. When released from a familiar ring, the spirit will recognize the person releasing them as their new master.$(br)
